paragraphs.text: The Echoverse is an alternate reality version of the Multiverse created by the planeswalker Jace Beleren .

In the aftermath of the New Phyrexian Invasion , Jace was traumatized by the devastation and the role he himself played in that as a compleated planeswalker. After undoing his compleation on Vryn , he decided to fix the Multiverse by creating an alternative to it , free of suffering. Though trying to make a perfect multiverse, what he defined as perfect came with his own biases. He excised people and events from the Echoverse's history as if they never existed. From there, the further creation and expansion of the Echoverse was mostly autonomous, and the ripples of reality created many unexpected results.
The Eldrazi do not exist.
Nicol Bolas does not exist.
The Phyrexians do not exist.
Instead of an Ur-Dragon , there is an Ur-Sphinx, who created all the Elder Sphinxes in the Echoverse.

Ajani Goldmane never forgave himself for his brother's death and became a vengeful red-aligned planeswalker who left a trail of carnage across the Echoverse as he sought revenge against those he judged responsible for his brother's death.
Jazal Goldmane was killed trying to broker peace during the Conflux Wars, instead of at a festival.
Amonkhet was conquered by Razaketh , instead of corrupted by Nicol Bolas,
The gods of Amonkhet are either dead or imprisoned in the afterlife, instead of living on the plane.
Since Razaketh blotted out its sun, the climate is significantly colder than its Multiverse counterpart, being permanently covered in snow.
Hapatra worshiped Kefnet instead of Rhonas , but abandoned her god when he refused to fight Razaketh. She now serves the undead monarchs who live in Amonkhet's desert.
Kefnet is alive, and is presumably imprisoned by Razaketh.
Razaketh is alive, and rules as a god of ice.
Samut rules as Naktamun 's tyrant, instead of its liberator and later vizier. She worships Razaketh instead of Hazoret . Her planeswalker spark never ignited.

Hexhaven Academy is the Echoverse's version of Strixhaven University , featuring five allied-colored colleges that focus on battle magic. Jace uses this place of abundant magical energy to stabilize his creation.
There are five Founder Sphinx on Arcavios instead of five Founder Dragons .
Hexhaven has a headmaster instead of a director. The current headmaster is Liliana Vess , not Taiva .
Abigale , Kirol , and Sanar , do not exist.
Codie is an evil sentient tome of dangerous magic, instead of a benign sentient tome of information.
The Indigo Revolution never happened. Thus, the Consulate was never overthrown, and still rules Avishkar .

Chandra Nalaar was trained by her father. As a result, she is much calmer and more collected than her Multiverse counterpart and is a cryomancer instead of a pyromancer. She is a Consulate enforcer alongside her father.
Kiran Nalaar didn't die and is a Consulate enforcer.
Pia Nalaar left Kiran over irreconcilable differences and became a druid rather than an artificer.
Saheeli Rai works as the head of the Consulate's intelligence network, instead of as an artist and inventor. Her planeswalker spark never ignited.
Goodhill was destroyed by King Glarb .
Cragflame is a staff instead of a sword, called Cragbane.

Mabel 's family was separated during their home's destruction, instead of being together. She now seeks to drain the Calamity Beasts of their powers using Cragbane to build enough power to challenge Glarb.

Ob Nixilis is an angel instead of a demon, having come to Capenna through a portal and swearing fealty to the plane's angels in exchange for having his demonic contract broken. His planeswalker spark never ignited.
There was a Second Brothers' War instead of a Phyrexian Invasion .
There was a civil war in Benalia in which the other houses turned on House Capashen, dethroning it as the most powerful house and forcing it into hiding.
Following the example of Lyra Dawnbringer , many Serran angels live in Tolaria rather than Benalia, and are interested in mechanical constructs .
The elves of Llanowar mechanised in response to Benalish expansion during the Second Brothers' War, cutting down many of the region's forests in the process.
Akroma is alive, and was created by Nivea instead of Ixidor . She is made of red mana instead of white, and is an avatar of Nivea's revenge instead of her beauty.
Belzenlok is alive, and rules over the Cabal .
Danitha Capashen is a knight in the Cabal, instead of Benalia, and serves as the right hand of Belzenlok .
Ixidor was killed in a battle with Tolarian wizards, taking the place of Nivea in the Echoverse, instead of dying when Lowallyn was killed.
Jhoira is still the captain of the Weatherlight, but she is a pirate rather than an artificer. She stole the Blackblade from the Cabal instead of Gideon Jura.
Josu Vess survived his disease thanks to his sister's healing, instead of dying from it.
Karn is made of gold instead of silver, and received his planeswalker spark from Mishra , instead of Urza .
Because she was able to save her brother, Liliana Vess never turned to necromancy, becoming a white -aligned healer instead. Her Planeswalker spark never ignited.
Lyra Dawnbringer is the headmaster and protector of the Tolarian Academy , instead of Benalia.
Marwyn is a warrior and lumberjack instead of a druid.
Mishra was a planeswalker , when his Multiverse counterpart was not.
Nivea is alive, instead of being killed.
Ragavan is a construct monkey, instead of a living one.
Tetsuko Umezawa is a bounty hunter instead of a rogue .
Tinybones grew into the towering Titanbones and became a druid rather than a thief, protecting Yavimaya instead of Urborg .
Traxos was rebuilt and reprogrammed by Lyra to protect Tolaria.
The Weatherlight is still active and operational, instead of being destroyed.
Venser is alive and is a self-serving thief instead of a wizard. He serves as Jhoira's first mate on the Weatherlight . His planeswalker spark never ignited.
Yargle has massive legs instead of arms, is a connoisseur of food rather than a glutton, and lives in Otaria instead of Urborg.
Marina Vendrell controls Valgavoth , rather than being bound to him through a pact.
Winter is an altruist who seeks to allow all of Duskmourn 's survivors to escape by killing Marina, instead of just trying to save himself.
Aniseed, the gingerbread man baked alongside Ginger , is alive. He married Ginger, and rules as a lord in her kingdom.
Ginger is a queen instead of a knight, and rules over a kingdom of animated confectionery.
Dack Fayden is alive, and is a rich philanthropist instead of a thief. His planeswalker spark never ignited.
Queen Marchesa is a known enemy of Dack, rather than being unaware of him.
Sifa Grent is alive and is Dack's business partner, rather than his enemy.
Teyo Verada is an assassin instead of a shieldmage. His planeswalker spark never ignited.
Werewolves dominate Innistrad instead of vampires , having been united into a single howlpack.

The Helvault was created to hold anything that might threaten humanity, instead of just demons . Avacyn used it as her own personal prison. It has still been destroyed in the Echoverse and its prisoners released.
The Church of Avacyn preaches faith beyond death, instead of rest in death. The geists of believers also serve Avacyn.
Avacyn still exists, is associated with the moon instead of the sun, and leads undead as well as humans and angels against Edgar Markov.
Edgar Markov is the founder of a pack of werewolves rather than a vampire house. He was imprisoned in the Helvault by his grandson but has since escaped and rules all the werewolves on Innistrad.
Griselbrand is alive.
Sigarda , Bruna , Gisela , and Liesa were all imprisoned in the Helvault for protesting against Avacyn's methods. They have since escaped
Sorin Markov is a werewolf instead of a vampire, and fights alongside Avacyn against Edgar.

Thalia was killed by Odric on Avacyn's orders when she questioned why other angels were imprisoned in the Helvault. Her geist has become a protective spirit at the cathedral where she was interred, and she has been canonised as a saint. She is the Echoverse's version of Saint Traft .
There are no predatory dinosaurs present on Ixalan .
Beckett Brass remains a pirate , but is known as much for dinosaur poaching as piracy.
Ghalta is a ceratopsian dinosaur, resembling a chasmosaur, instead of a theropod. She got her name from her endurance, rather than her ferocity.
Arni is an omenseeker instead of a warrior.
Kamigawa's internal conflict is between venerating its past and moving towards its future, instead of balancing the material and spiritual worlds.
Tamiyo is alive, and rules as Emperor of Kamigawa instead of the Wanderer , having claimed the throne in a coup.
Yoshimaru is a stray dog, instead of the Emperor's pet.
Yuriko is a samurai who serves as Emperor Tamiyo's bodyguard, rather than being a ninja vigilante.
Lluwen does not exist.
Karn sacrificed his spark to create Mirrodin, instead of to heal Ajani and Nissa Revane .
Mirrodin was never compleated .
Karn never left Mirrodin to travel the Multiverse, and lives there permanently as its protector and shepherd.
Koth is a farmer instead of a warrior, and he has a family where he didn't in the Multiverse. His planeswalker spark never ignited.
Memnarch is alive and completely sane, assisting Karn in shaping Mirrodin to be better for its inhabitants.
Alquist Proft is a criminal mastermind, instead of a detective , who controls most of the crime on Ravnica . He is widely believed to be a myth by the general population.
Fblthp was created to help an Izzet mage navigate the city. He always knows his way, instead of constantly getting lost, and with his creator's death, travels the Multiverse of his own volition.
Massacre Girl is a Selesnya Cleric instead of a Rakdos assassin. She is known as "Rescue Girl".
The Obzedat were destroyed by Niv-Mizzet instead of Kaya Cassir .

Niv-Mizzet became a spirit dragon after being slain by the nephilim following Ravnica's decamillennial . Having planned for his death, Niv-Mizzet purchased a series of life insurance policies that forced the Orzhov Syndicate to pay him an exorbitant amount of money so that he could purchase a seat on the Ghost Council . Over time, Niv drained the fortunes of the other patriarchs and devoured them, leaving himself as the sole ruler of the Syndicate. While no longer officially affiliated with the Izzet League, rumors persist that he guides it in secret.
Ral Zarek is an Orzhov lawmage rather than an Izzet storm mage.
Ruric Thar is a Simic biomancer instead of a Gruul warrior.
Tomik Vrona is an Izzet sparkmage rather than an Orzhov advokist and former guildmaster.

Vraska was raised in an unguilded support network and was never discriminated against. She cannot petrify, instead having learnt to create animated sculptures. She remains unguilded and works as Hexhaven Academy's architect. Her Planeswalker spark never ignited. She does not love Jace.
Garruk willingly donned the Chain Veil to suppress his beastly nature.
Kothophed is alive, and was the one who called to Garruk from the Onakke Catacombs .
Jiang Yanggu is a violent vigilante rather than a healer, who hunts criminals while trying to find Mowu 's killers. His planeswalker spark never ignited.
Mowu is dead, killed by unknown assailants.
Gallia is a Returned , instead of being alive.
Gideon Jura is alive and is a self-serving mercenary, instead of a selfless hero. His planeswalker spark never ignited.
Heliod is a Titan , rather than a sun god. He was defeated by Gideon instead of Elspeth Tirel .
The Theorist uses Maag Taranau to hold dangerous things and individuals.
Loot remains imprisoned in Maag Taranau, instead of being released by Jace and Vraska. The wrongness of the Echoverse has transformed Loot into a horror .
There is no Echoverse version of Jace Beleren. His role is taken by Tam on Arcavios.
Zendikar wasn't used as a prison for, or attacked by, the Eldrazi.
The Kor Empire holds sway over all of Zendikar. It has nature stripped from the plane and replaced with artifice. Elves and merfolk were subjugated.

Kiora is a dragon rider with no affinity for sea creatures. She wields the Hammer of Purphoros , gifted to her by an unknown planewalker instead of Thassa 's bident. Her Planeswalker spark never ignited.
Nissa Revane is a wizard specialising in manipulating leylines , instead of a druid. She foments an elven rebellion against the kor. Her Planeswalker spark never ignited.
Omnath is alive, and is an elemental of void instead of natural forces.

The Echoverse is far from perfect, populated by eerie doppelgangers and warped versions of many heroes and villains. And it's hungry. To sustain itself, it needs to consume everything it imitates. The only way to give it stability is to lay its skin atop the bones of the existing Multiverse. For Jace, the key to this step was understanding the creation of Arcavios — how the collision of two planes had created something new and stable.
Now, the only way to prevent the Multiverse itself from being overwritten is to take down its creator. For this purpose, the Gatewatch assembles to fight one of its founding members.

After Jace is killed by Vraska, the overlay of the Echoverse onto the Multiverse is prevented, though both realities remain intertwined. Tam , having received Jace's planeswalker spark , summons Emrakul directly from Innistrad's moon via telepathy. The Eldrazi travels to the Echoverse and consumes it, simultaneously severing it from the Multiverse.
